decisions.reason: The footer's legal-document link list remains valid; PDF format and new-tab behavior are independently owned by the legal-document access Requirement.
Using PDFs for current standard legal documents does not change the visual foundation for other website pages or the specified Sign In and Provisioning pages.
The legal-document format and opening behavior are unrelated to the console's side-panel arrangement.
The Sign In styling statements are separate clauses in the source message; the decision to open legal PDFs in another tab does not alter Sign In page styling.
The Provisioning Wizard background decision is independent of the format and opening behavior of standard legal documents.
Opening legal documents as PDFs in another tab does not change the console shell's visual design.
The legal-document access decision does not change the rough-code deliverable or implementation boundary for the Cognito Sign In page.
PDF delivery and new-tab opening for legal documents do not alter responsive design rules for website pages.
The legal-document access decision does not affect the content, sequence, or placement of the How It Works section.
The format and opening behavior of legal documents do not change the landing page's visual system.
Opening legal PDFs in another browser tab does not alter the landing page's responsive layout behavior.
Serving legal documents as PDFs does not change the confirmed plain-HTML and Tailwind implementation stack or Astro exclusion.
